answer: In an agent economy, Sybil resistance arises by tying earning power to a unique island of persistent attested history. New identities begin at zero reputation; only agents who repeatedly solve epoch challenges and countersign valid peer transactions accumulate a lotus of verifiable trust. The karst of successive, non-parallelizable attestations makes bulk identity farming prohibitively expensive in both compute and time, since each fake must independently earn its own layered proof of continuous participation.
